QuestInfo.name: Dirty Tactics
QuestInfo.0: #p1033102# says that the water of #m101050000# has been poisoned. How did this happen? Talk to #b#p1033102##k.
QuestInfo.1: Something must have happened to the #bfountainhead#k to taint the village water supply. Go check it out.
QuestInfo.2: The Black Wings were responsible for poisoning the village water. You had to defeat them and add more security to the fountainhead to prevent this from happening again.

0.0: We're purifying as much water as we can, but we simply can't purify enough of it. Our streams have been clean for thousands of years. Please, Your Highness, would you check on the fountainhead?

yes.0: #p1033100# is busy researching the curse, and #p1033101# just can't focus on anything but battle... I'd go myself, Your Highness, but I'm just too old for this stuff. I know it's not my place to ask such things, but please, your people need you.
yes.1: You do remember where the fountainhead is, of course. It's just #boutside through the Path of the Glowcaves#k.

no.0: Of course, Your Majesty. You know what is best. Then shall we, erm, drink the posioned water?

1.0: The fountainhead was targeted by the Black Wings? Oh my... The Cygnus Knights are doing a good job of protecting the village itself, but we can't watch everything that happens all around us...

yes.0: I doubt they'll try this again, but we should ask the Cygnus Knights to keep the fountainhead safe, as well. I'll see to it, Your Majesty.

quest.0: Have you checked on the #bfountainhead#k, Your Majesty? This is quite a concern...
